cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: The getNotes method returns unescaped user input (notes field) which could contain malicious JavaScript code, leading to Cross-site Scripting (XSS) when rendered in a web page.
The setNotes method stores raw user input without any sanitization or validation, which could later be retrieved and rendered unsafely via getNotes.
